summary: In a cluster any instance can pick a job from the dispatcher queue; a job fails permanently if its instance dies. Projects sync to the needed revision on the running instance just before the job (recorded as launch_type sync), and Galaxy or collection downloads use /tmp, which large projects can fill.
questions: What happens to a job if a controller node fails?
What is a project update with launch_type sync?
Why does /tmp fill up on controller nodes?
How are projects synced across cluster nodes?
